content: Floci (MIT, floci-io/floci) is a LocalStack-compatible local AWS emulator supporting 69 services incl. Glue Data Catalog+Schema Registry and Athena (via DuckDB sidecar). Serves /_localstack/init and /_localstack/health for compatibility; init scripts under /etc/localstack/init/ run unchanged. Configured via docker-compose on port 4566, env vars FLOCI_PORT/FLOCI_STORAGE_MODE/FLOCI_HOSTNAME/FLOCI_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_ID.
